subject: Re: Olive Labs accelerator — combining promo credits with Dedicated discount
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara@olivelabs.co>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Olive Labs accelerator cohort — combining promo credit with dedicated quote

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for running the demo yesterday — Olive Labs is excited about the latency and cost profiles you showed. Our accelerator (cohort Q1 2027) gives us $20k in Redwood promo credits if we sign up for the program.

We also have a technical need to move to Dedicated for predictable throughput. Legal asked if the accelerator promo credits can be combined with a 12‑month Dedicated commitment (we were quoted a 15% committed discount). Is there a way to stack the credits so the first three months of Dedicated are covered by the promo, and then the committed discount applies thereafter?

Also looping in legal (cc) who will want contract language if this is possible.

Best,
Sara
Sara Nguyen
Head of Platform Partnerships, Olive Labs
attachments: accelerator_summary.pdf (summary, 1 page)

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@olivelabs.co>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Legal Team <legal@olivelabs.co>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Olive Labs accelerator cohort — combining promo credit with dedicated quote

Sara — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the summary. Short answer: we can often structure a glidepath that uses promo credits for onboarding and then applies a committed discount, but it requires approval from finance (credits are typically promotional and not combinable with other discounts by default).

Proposed path:
- Apply the $20k accelerator promo as a one‑time onboarding voucher that offsets the first 3 months of Dedicated usage.
- Apply the 12‑month committed discount (15%) on net usage after onboarding credits are consumed.
- Add explicit language in the SOW so both sides are clear about sequencing and what happens if consumption falls short.

I'm looping in Ben (sales lead) and Priyom (pricing/finance) to scope the risk and generate a draft MAP + contract language. Can you confirm the expected monthly throughput (tokens/month) for the first 6 months so we can size the Dedicated pool for pricing?

I'll attach a sample MAP and an example terms redline for your counsel to review.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
attachments: olive_accelerator_terms_redline.pdf, MAP_OliveLabs_v1.xlsx

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Legal Team <legal@olivelabs.co>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 13:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Olive Labs accelerator cohort — combining promo credit with dedicated quote

Thanks — jumping in. Vanessa has the right approach. A couple of operational notes from sales ops/finance perspective:

1) We need a confirmed minimum committed spend number to reserve Dedicated capacity. For a clean approval, we usually ask customers to commit to at least 3 months of baseline usage or a $30k minimum over 12 months (whichever is higher) to protect capacity.

2) If Olive prefers, we can structure credits to appear as a prepaid credit on the invoice and apply them to early invoices; that keeps billing tidy and avoids re‑rating discounts retroactively.

If Olive can share expected tokens/month or an estimated $/month for months 1‑6 I can run the math and we can propose two options: (A) credits-as-onboarding + standard 15% commit; (B) credits converted to a reduced first‑quarter invoice and a 10% commit (tradeoff between cashflow and discount).

Happy to jump on a 30min call today to run numbers.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Sara Nguyen <sara@olivelabs.co>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@olivelabs.co>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Olive Labs accelerator cohort — combining promo credit with dedicated quote

Ben/Vanessa — thanks. Rough usage: we expect ~400M tokens mo in months 1‑3 (onboarding + trial), then 200M tokens mo months 4‑12. Conservatively that maps to roughly $9k/mo for months 1‑3, $4.5k/mo months 4‑12 (based on the demo profile).

Dollar math: $20k credits would more than cover months 1‑3 and leave a small balance. Olive prefers option A (credits-as-onboarding + 15% commit) if finance can sign off. Legal will want a short SOW clause documenting the credit burn sequence.

—Sara

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara@olivelabs.co>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@olivelabs.co>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Olive Labs accelerator cohort — combining promo credit with dedicated quote

Thanks for the usage estimate — that helps. Finance view and decision path:

- We can approve credits-as-onboarding in this case provided the customer signs a 12‑month SOW with the 15% committed discount and minimum annual spend of $36k (based on your numbers). That protects capacity and our forecasting.
- Credits will be represented as prepayment credits on the invoice. Any unused promo credit after month 3 does not convert to cash; it expires per accelerator program terms.
- Risk: if consumption drops below the minimum in months 4‑12, we will true‑up to the committed minimum and bill the difference. We'll include a simple true‑up clause in the SOW.

Ben/Vanessa — please add the $36k minimum to the MAP and draft the SOW language. Sara — once legal signs off we can generate a DocuSign envelope.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Revenue & Pricing Operations, Redwood Inference
